The Bakery

A neighbourhood counter, still doing it the old way

Tucked into Poonthottam, Agarathirumalam, Sri Raghavendra Iyengar Bakery is the kind of shop where the smell of the morning bake reaches the street before the shutters are even fully up. It's known locally as a straightforward, no-frills bakery and cake shop — the sort of place people stop at on the way to work for a rusk and a cup of tea.

Like the Iyengar bakeries this region is famous for, the shelves stay stocked with whole-wheat loaves, crisp rusk, and a rotating tray of savouries — the kind of everyday baking that doesn't chase trends, just consistency.
